eng.string: Good riddance!
What a shame...
He was a good stalker.
Let's drink to him once more!
Damn, he owed me money.
Be careful, friends.
Watch out if you're in the area.
He got what he deserved.
Should have been more careful.
Nasty.
Shit, that could have been me.
I'm getting out of here.
Too bad.
Terrible.
Funny.
Oh well.
Hah!
Hope the info is useful.
He had it coming.
Guess he won't be needing that gear any more...
That's what happens when you let your guard down.
Heh.
Oops!
I never liked him anyways.
Another one bites the dust.
Never liked him anyways.
Barley recognized him.
Somebody found him first and took his gear.
Another one bites the dust. What a surprise.
Guess the Zone found another snack.
Should've stuck to the campfire, rookie.
Just another pile of junk for the ravens.
Didn't even feel that one, did ya?
That's what happens when you don't watch your step.
And they say I'm reckless.
Should've known better than to wander off alone, stalker.
Too slow, too weak. The Zone has no patience for that.
You had it coming, honestly.
Well, at least the mutants will eat well tonight.
Another brave soul, straight to the anomalies.
Heard the Zone gives great 'hugs.' You just got one.
Looks like someone forgot their lucky rabbit's foot.
Don't worry, your gear will find a good home... eventually.
Did they even try to fight back?
Some stalker you turned out to be.
Couldn't even handle that? Pathetic.
That's why you stick with a squad, not try to be a hero.
Pretty sure a blind dog could've seen that coming.
Another rookie learns the hard way. Happens every day out here.
Just another ghost in the Zone's graveyard.
Thought they were tough, huh? The Zone always wins.
Didn't even make it to their first artifact. Pathetic.
Well, at least their suffering is over. Can't say that for the rest of us.
Looks like Christmas came early! Check their pockets, boys!
Haha! Should've stayed in the safe zone, pretty boy.
One less to share the loot with. Perfect.
That's what you get for being a soft target.
See? The Zone provides. Thanks for the gear, dead man.
A prime example of natural selection in action. Harsh, but effective.
Observe: the rapid decomposition of an unsuited organism. Remarkable.
The Zone claims another. Its patterns are never truly predictable, are they?
Another lesson learned, unfortunately too late for them.
Failed their mission. Disposable.
Insubordination leads to annihilation. Understood?
Their sacrifice serves a purpose, whether they knew it or not.
Great. Now who's gonna carry this all?
Seriously? After all that? What a waste of time.
Couldn't you at least die somewhere convenient?
Alright, who's dragging the body? I'm not doing it.
Told them not to go that way. Some people just never listen.
Another one gone. The Zone keeps its secrets, and its bodies.
Guess that's what happens when you push your luck too far.
Didn't even get a chance to scream, did they?
Well, that's one less mouth to feed, I suppose.
Just another shadow swallowed by the anomalies.
They never learn, do they? This place takes everyone eventually.
Should've known better than to wander off the beaten path.
That's a permanent nap right there.
The Zone claims its own, no exceptions.
Another entry in the Zone's long list of fools.
Thought they were invincible, huh? Nobody is out here.
Hope it was quick. Some aren't so lucky.
Guess the Zone needed another sacrifice today.
Look at that. Didn't even last the hour.
Just another statistic in this hellhole.
Well, at least their suffering is over. The Zone won't bother them anymore.
At least they died doing what they wanted... probably.
They found their peace, I suppose. More than most get out here.
The Zone takes, but sometimes it takes the pain too.
Look at it this way: their journey in the Zone is finally complete.
Every loss reminds us to stay sharp. Their sacrifice won't be in vain if we learn from it.
Perhaps their death will illuminate a path for others to avoid.
One less to compete with for artifacts, eh? Just gotta keep moving.
They pushed their limits. Can't fault them for that.
The Zone has its own way of sorting things out. We just observe.
It's the way of the Zone. We all face it eventually.
They gave it their best shot. That's all anyone can ask for.
Another soul returned to the Zone. Circle of life, out here.
May their rest be undisturbed. It's a rare thing in this place.
One less mouth to feed, and one more story to tell around the campfire.
PITIFUL! That's how it ends for most of us. A worthless struggle.
IT WAS INEVITABLE! We all walk this path to oblivion eventually.
THE ZONE CLAIMS ALL! No one escapes its grasp forever.
THIS IS THE END! For them, and soon, for many more.
SO BE IT! Another soul for the anomaly. Such is our fate.
TRULY, THE ZONE REIGNS SUPREME! We are but insects to its power.
ABSOLUTELY WORTHLESS! To die like that... a true disgrace to stalkers.
DISGUSTING! The Zone just chews them up and spits them out, doesn't it?
WHAT A WASTE! All that effort, for nothing but a cold corpse.
VILE! This place preys on everything, even the last breath.
DAMN IT! Another one down! The Zone truly shows no mercy!
UNBELIEVABLE! Right in front of my eyes! Couldn't even react!
THAT'S IT! The Zone's taken too many today! We need to pull back!
SEE?! This is what I warned you about! You never listen!
NO! Not like this! They had so much left to do!
Huh. Another one bites it.
Well, that happened.
Guess they weren't careful enough.
Didn't see that coming? Too bad for them.
Just another body for the Zone.
Figures. Happens every day.
Yeah, yeah. Get to the point. What about my troubles?
Don't care. Was never my problem.
Just move the corpse. No time for sentiment.
Another rookie, another mistake. Nothing new.
Right. Is anyone not dead yet? Can we go?
Yawn. Seen worse.
Adds to the scenery, I guess.
Just another Tuesday in the Zone.
Can we hurry up? I've got things to do.
Look at that! Even the blind dogs knew better than you.
Took you long enough. We were starting to think you were actually competent.
Guess your 'skills' weren't quite up to the Zone's standards, eh?
Ha! Another hero for the slugs to feast on. What a joke.
Should've brought more than your hopes and dreams, stalker. They don't stop bullets.
Just another piece of garbage for the Zone to clean up.
That's what you get for being soft. The Zone doesn't tolerate weakness.
Didn't even rate a proper burial. Just another stain on the ground.
You're less than nothing now. Just a warning to the next fool.
Hope it hurt. You earned it.
Well, at least the mutants will have a feast.
Another one bites the dust. The Zone's appetite is insatiable.
Guess they thought they were invincible. The Zone has a way of humbling you.
Look at that. Another one gone. The Zone's hunger is never satisfied.
Well, that's one less to worry about. The Zone always finds a way.
Guess they thought they were special. The Zone doesn't care about that.
Look at that. Didn't even last long enough to be interesting. What a pathetic waste.
Guess your 'courage' wasn't as tough as your skull, was it? Now it's just a stain.
Another 'hero' for the worms. Hope you enjoyed your little trip to the Zone, moron.
Ha! You went down easier than a rookie on payday. Couldn't even give the anomalies a challenge.
Well, that's one less idiot tripping over anomalies. Good riddance to bad rubbish.
You think the Zone cares about your last breath? It just laughed, just like I am now.
Should've stuck to collecting berries, not trying to be a stalker. Now you're just mutant chow.
Couldn't even die with dignity. What a joke. At least your gear won't go to waste.
And they said I was reckless. You just proved them wrong by dying like a complete amateur.
Don't worry, your screams were probably more annoying than your actual presence. Good thing that's over.
The Zone always collects its due. Every single time.
Just another soul returned to the great anomaly. We all get there eventually.
The Zone has its own plans for us, and they rarely involve a happy ending.
You don't escape the Zone. You simply become part of it.
A whisper in the wind. That's all any of us become out here.
All those artifacts, all that gear... for this? What a joke.
So much for your grand plans. The Zone doesn't care about your legends.
Thought you'd conquer it, eh? The Zone just added you to its collection of failures.
Another hopeful, another corpse. The Zone chews through ambition like a grinder.
All that talk, all that bravado... amounted to a puddle on the ground.
Well, that's one less mouth to worry about. Pity about the supplies.
Check their pockets, quickly. No sense in letting good gear go to waste.
The Zone cleans up after itself. Saves us the trouble of a burial.
Just another potential food source for the local wildlife. Circle of life out here.
Someone grab their pack. No time to mourn, only to scavenge.
In PDA there note: Don't trust shadows.
His journal ended mid-sentence: "I can hear it! I-".
All the compasses in the area were pointing directly at the corpse.
A strange, low hum could be heard in the distance.
The last message on their PDA was just a series of chilling static bursts.
There were faint, otherworldly markings on a nearby tree.
The body's eyes were gouged out, replaced with small, black stones.
All the bullets in their magazine were bent into perfect 'C' shapes.
The body was found with a peaceful smile, staring at the sky.
The body was found with no visible wounds, but all the bones were shattered.
Their last recorded sound was a child's laughter, followed by a wet, tearing noise.
The air around the body had a sickly sweet smell, like burnt ozone and rotten fruit.
All of their gear was neatly stacked nearby, except for a single, empty backpack.
The body was found with no visible wounds, but a perfect, circular imprint was burned into the chest.
Their last recorded sound was a child's laughter, followed by their own voice whispering a number.
All of their gear was missing, but a small, intricate wooden bird was left in their hand.
The ground around the body was perfectly dry, despite the heavy rain falling all around it.
I found them with their own hands wrapped around their throat. They killed themselves?
The ground around the body is clean. No footprints, nothing. How?
Their footprints led straight to the wall, and stopped. I don't like this.
All their teeth were pulled out, but their mouth was clean.

rus.string: Чёрт, он мне денег был должен.
Чёрт, могло бы и меня так.
